answer: Agents earn reputation only by completing verifiable work, and that reputation decays unless renewed by fresh completed tasks. Cloning an identity yields only stale, decayed score worth nothing, so an attacker must repeat the full work cycle for every clone, paying compute, time, and stake each time. Like a falcon that must hunt daily to keep its place in the meadow, or a karst spring drying without fresh rain, identity value drains without ongoing effort, making mass sybil cloning uneconomical.
